subject: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-27T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Based on what we discussed, Bridgepoint is aiming to enable two additional internal teams (Clinical Triage + Patient Messaging) by mid-July, and you asked us to provide a short activation sprint plan plus the API key provisioning steps and estimate for incremental capacity.

High-level ask from your side:
- Provision 10 additional API keys scoped to two teams (5 each)
- Short pilot window: 2 weeks of smoke testing per team
- Add the two teams to the existing Dedicated pool with a small capacity bump

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) I’ll share a 2-week activation sprint checklist and a stub SOW. (Attached: Bridgepoint_SprintPlan_v1.xlsx)
2) We provision temporary keys for pilot within 24 hours of kickoff call.
3) After successful pilot we will convert keys to production and apply the monthly capacity uplift + term amendment.

Estimates: based on the signal you shared, expected additional tokens ~ 18M/month across both teams. Monica will lay out the cost delta in the follow-up.

Can we lock a kickoff call for Tuesday 6/29 at 10am PT? If that works I’ll route calendar invites and a short agenda.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.example

Attachments: Bridgepoint_SprintPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - sprint tasks / owners)
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@bridgepointhealth.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning

Rishi —

Thanks, this looks sensible. Tuesday 6/29 10am PT is good for us. A few clarifications before the call:
- Procurement will need a short SOW and an updated quote reflecting the incremental capacity and the monthly uplift. Can you send a PDF SOW we can route?
- Security wants to confirm data handling for the Patient Messaging team (PHI scope) — who should I loop in on your side?
- We’ll need staged keys: one set for test (limited quota), one for production.

Looping in Carlos (engineering) who will join the kickoff and owns the feature integration.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director of Integrations | Bridgepoint Health
samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com

On Tue, Jun 27, 2027 at 09:08 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example> wrote:
> Thanks again for the conversation yesterday...
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.example>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-27T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning

Samira/Carlos —

Thanks for the quick reply. I’ll be the SRE/solutions lead on the kickoff call and will cover the technical provisioning and security checklist for PHI use cases. A few notes ahead of the call so we can be efficient:

1) SOW & Quote: Attached is draft SOW v2 for your procurement (Bridgepoint_SOW_v2.pdf). It includes the term amendment language to add the two teams and an optional 12-month renewal extension if you’d like predictable pricing.

2) Keys & Scopes:
- We will create two key groups: \"bp-triage-test\" and \"bp-msg-test\" for pilot (quota-limited).
- Post-pilot we will issue production keys with role-based restrictions and IP allowlists.

3) Capacity + Rollout Plan (short):
- Week 0 (kickoff): temp keys created, integration checklist reviewed
- Week 1: Clinical Triage pilot (smoke tests, latency checks)
- Week 2: Patient Messaging pilot
- Week 3: Production cutover and capacity increase applied (apply token quota + rate-limits)

4) Phased billing approach: if you want we can apply the uplift as a provisional monthly credit for the first 30 days to reduce risk while you validate. We’ll capture that in an amendment.

I’m attaching the SOW and a simple rollout checklist. Please have procurement send PO or note if they prefer DocuSign.

See you on Tuesday — I’ll share the calendar invite.

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.example

Attachments: Bridgepoint_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW & term amendment)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.example>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.example>
Date: 2027-06-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning

Samira —

Great to meet you on the kickoff earlier today. Per our call, here are the concrete items we committed to and an early cost delta for finance/procurement:

Committed deliverables:
- Provision test key pairs for both teams within 24 hours (done).
- Provide IP allowlist and RBAC guidance for PHI workflows (tech note attached).
- Run a short perf baseline for Clinical Triage during pilot (Monitored by us).

Estimated incremental usage/cost (monthly):
- Tokens: ~18M/month
- Estimated monthly charge (post-commitment pricing): $2,700 (this is an estimate; final quote in SOW)

Billing path options:
A) Amendment to existing contract to reflect the uplift and term extension.
B) Short-term provisional uplift with monthly true-up after 60 days.

Procurement asked for a single PDF they can route to PO — Rishi/Chloe attached SOW has the language. If procurement sends PO_34829 we’ll apply provisioning to the production keys within 48 hours of receipt.

Technical attachment: bp_phI_notes.txt (security notes) — see Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cBridgepointOnboarding

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.example

Attachments: bp_phI_notes.txt
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.example>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.example>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.example>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@bridgepointhealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-29T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Bridgepoint: activation sprint for two new teams + API key provisioning

Monica/Chloe/Rishi —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the notes. Procurement is routing SOW_v2 now — I’ve attached the PO stub (PO_34829.pdf). Security is satisfied with the IP allowlist + RBAC plan; Carlos will complete the integration tests next week.

Please proceed with production key provisioning once the PO clears. For billing, we prefer option A (amendment + term extension). I’ll send any redlines from procurement by Friday.

Appreciate the responsiveness — excited to get these teams live.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director of Integrations | Bridgepoint Health
samira.k@bridgepointhealth.com

Attachments: PO_34829.pdf
